attBesluta.text: You have to assemble it yourself. But it's a very good birthday gift!

Good car for toddlers... the bucket is a neat feature that barely works (would be really difficult for a toddler to use it to pick up sand for example) but it adds something different that is lots of fun for the little ones.
The solid table frame mounts quickly without complex tools. Massive matching accessories fit most compatible track sets well.
The full play set includes a powered train and complete track pieces. Minor loose magnet connections appear on the train unit.
The reversible tabletop supports both track play and drawing. Built-in storage keeps all small accessories organized tidily.
It has premium material and straightforward assembly steps. I wish the overall table height could be taller for growing kids.
My grandson loves this train play table. It feels solid and durable for long daily play. Assembly takes time but is not hard to finish.
This table stays intact after multiple toddlers climb and play on it daily. Its solid frame resists shaking and wear well over months.
My grandson spends hours playing with toy trucks and dirt on this table. It holds up well to rough daily kid use.
The table uses solid material and features a simple assembly process. Its stable structure supports long-term kid play use.

I bought this in October 2026, and I’m really happy with it! It was very easy to assemble, and the materials feel high-quality and durable. The two boards are brilliant: one side is magnetic, while the other can be used for drawing with chalk. This gives children so many possibilities for creative and independent play. The storage boxes are another great feature. They’re perfect for sensory play, building with blocks, or keeping toys and other play materials organised. Overall, it’s a very well-designed and versatile piece that encourages creativity, exploration, and hands-on learning. A great addition to any child’s play space!
